statement: You are given a string number that holds a large non-negative integer.
Return the substring of number, as a string, whose value is the largest odd integer among all non-empty substrings. Return an empty string if no odd integer appears.
Since a number is odd exactly when its last digit is odd, the answer is the prefix of number that ends at its rightmost odd digit.

examples.explanation: The rightmost odd digit is the 7. Everything after it is a 0, so the longest odd substring is "35427".
Every digit is even, so no substring is an odd number and the answer is empty.

constraints: number consists only of digits and has no leading zeros
